summary: End-to-end test of the new Phase-2 Vendor / Agency Management + Vendor Ledger module. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_vendors_module.py — meta (8 agency_types, 6 bill_statuses), CRUD (create with extended fields → id vnd_*, active, documents=[]; list with outstanding rollup; q= search; agency_type filter; detail with summary total_billed/total_paid/outstanding/open_bills/task_count/project_count + bills/payments/tasks/projects arrays; PATCH partial update; PATCH invalid agency_type → 400; soft-delete sets active=false + deleted_at, still findable in DB), documents attach + remove (verified via detail GET), ratings (composite = avg of 4 dims; multiple ratings correctly averaged 4.0 + 5.0 = 4.5 on vendor.rating), bills (create computes subtotal 50000/tax 9000/tds 500/total 58500/outstanding 58500/status=received; PATCH re-computes; invalid status→400; delete unpaid=hard-delete, delete paid=soft-cancel), payments (creates balanced 2-line JE DR Accounts Payable / CR bank, source='vendor_payment'; bill status flips to partially_paid then paid; FIFO across open bills works; bill_splits sums + unallocated = amount), ledger (running balance == outstanding; entries chronological), performance (score 0-100 with 30/25/35/10 weights). RBAC verified: Designer read=200/create=403/bills=403/payments=403; Employee read=200/create=403; HR read=403; Accountant full 200 on vendors+bills+payments. Frontend: /vendors page renders (hero 'Every hand that builds. In one place.', KPI strip 12 vendors/5 contractors/3 suppliers/₹1,05,950 outstanding, search + type filter). Sidebar '06 Vendors' nav present. 'New vendor' opens 3-section form; save creates vendor and refreshes list. Clicking vendor name navigates to /vendors/vnd_*. All 7 tabs render (overview/ledger/bills/payments/projects/documents/performance). Overview shows 4 rating sliders + submit-rating-btn (submission increments rating count and refetches page). Bills tab: new-bill-btn opens inline form with bf-date + line item description input + save-bill-btn. Payments tab: new-payment-btn opens form with pf-amount + pf-bank (4 bank/cash options from /api/accounts) + save-payment-btn. Ledger tab renders rows (2 rows for seed ACME vendor). Documents tab has add-doc-btn. Performance tab shows Overall performance gauge (59.9/100) + Task Execution + Client-facing Ratings + Payment Reliability cards.
action_items: (Nit) Vendor list row is not clickable — only the vendor name link and the 'Open' button navigate. Consider making the whole row clickable for better UX (currently working through the name link or Open button).

(Legacy hygiene, out-of-scope for this iter) /app/backend/tests/test_attendance_accounting.py uses hardcoded stale URL and token 'test_session_admin_001' which no longer exist — TestBackwardCompat class 404s. Not a regression of any endpoint; simply update the token to `stable_testtok_do_not_delete` and remove the hardcoded URL fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/vendors.py:_refresh_bill_status handles due-date parsing with a broad try/except — fine.
vendor list rollup does an async find per vendor (N+1). Fine at current scale but consider a single $group aggregation over vendor_bills once vendor count grows.

vendor_payments create builds journal_entry inline (duplicates the logic already in routes/accounting._post_journal). Not a bug — comment even calls it out — but a future refactor to expose _post_journal at module level would remove drift risk between the two write paths.
delete_vendor_bill: hard-delete of an unpaid bill is silent — no audit trail. Consider always soft-cancel with a 'deleted' status for full auditability (minor).
GET /vendors performs outstanding rollup even when the caller only needs a lightweight picker — a `slim=true` query flag would help downstream lookup dropdowns.
vendor rating endpoint accepts any 0-5 floats but does not enforce range (a rating of 99 would go through and skew averages). Add pydantic ge=0, le=5 constraints.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all vendor list + detail flows + testids verified)

test_credentials: Bearer stable_testtok_do_not_delete (cookie session_token=same). Additional per-role test users (Designer/Employee/HR/Accountant) are auto-seeded by the test fixture.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_ prefixed vendors, bills, payments, ratings, documents; per-role users with TEST_ email prefixes. Not cleaned up (audit trail). Volumes small.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor module is fully green. Re-run backend: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_vendors_module.py -o addopts='' -v`. Vendor payments always route through routes/vendors.create_vendor_payment which writes a balanced journal_entry with source='vendor_payment'. If adding vendor-related invoicing later, keep going through vendor_bills → vendor_payments for consistency. The vendors_acc collection is backward compatible with the old accounting.vendor_ledger endpoint.
